high_level_description: This image is a vibrant and futuristic artwork featuring a character dressed as an astronaut with cat ears. The astronaut is depicted in a space suit, with their hands clasped together in front of them, as if in prayer or contemplation. The background is a neon-lit scene with the words "Outer Space" prominently displayed in bright pink neon lights. The setting appears to be a modern, urban environment with a brick wall painted in shades of blue and teal. The overall mood of the image is whimsical and otherworldly, blending elements of science fiction with a playful twist.
